user.title: Set up Becker USB hub
user.description: Select the Becker USB stick and an existing rolling-counter database. The UI will never create or replace this database.

data_description.filename: Must be an existing centronic-stick.db inside the Home Assistant config folder.

import_yaml.title: Import existing Becker setup
import_yaml.description: Found {cover_count} existing covers on {device}, using {database}. Continue to copy this setup into a passive UI hub. YAML remains active until you explicitly complete the migration.

cover.title: Add a Becker cover
cover.description: {cover_count} covers added so far. Only sender units already paired in the selected database are offered.

error.database_missing: The existing Becker counter database was not found.
error.database_outside_config: The database must be stored inside the Home Assistant config folder.
error.invalid_database: This file is not an intact Becker counter database with sender units 1737b–1737f.
error.invalid_cover_config: The existing cover configuration could not be imported safely.
error.device_not_found: The selected serial device is not currently available.
error.duplicate_channel: This channel has already been added.
error.sender_not_configured: This sender unit is not paired in the selected database.

abort.already_configured: This Becker USB hub is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Becker USB hub can own the stick and counter database.
abort.yaml_not_found: No active Becker YAML setup was found.

activate.title: Activate the imported UI hub
activate.description: Continue only after the legacy Becker YAML platform has been removed and Home Assistant has restarted. The existing counter database will be reused without being changed or recreated.

hub.title: Becker hub settings
hub.description: Change only to another stable serial path or another existing, valid counter database.

cover_options.title: Configure {name}
cover_options.description: Channel {channel} remains unchanged. Supplying at least one travel time enables position tracking and the position slider.

data_description.travelling_time_up: Seconds from fully closed to fully open. If only one direction is entered, it is used for both.
data_description.travelling_time_down: Seconds from fully open to fully closed.
data_description.value_template: Optional advanced template returning 0–100, open/closed, true/false, or an unknown value.
data_description.remote_id: Optional IDs such as 12345:2. Separate multiple IDs with commas.
data_description.intermediate_position_up: Home Assistant position in percent for the programmed UP double-press target.
data_description.intermediate_position_down: Home Assistant position in percent for the programmed DOWN double-press target.

blind_options.title: Configure slats for {name}
blind_options.description: These controls are only exposed for venetian blinds on channel {channel}.

data_description.tilt_mode: Intermediate maps tilt buttons to programmed intermediate targets. Blind sends a short UP/DOWN pulse.

error.yaml_still_active: The legacy Becker YAML platform is still loaded. Remove it and restart Home Assistant before activation.
error.database_missing: The existing Becker counter database was not found.
error.database_outside_config: The database must be stored inside the Home Assistant config folder.
error.invalid_database: This file is not an intact Becker counter database.
error.device_not_found: The selected serial device is not currently available.
error.invalid_cover_config: These cover settings are not valid.
error.invalid_remote_id: Use five hexadecimal characters, a colon, and one channel character, for example 12345:2.
error.tilt_requires_intermediate: Intermediate tilt controls require programmed intermediate positions to be enabled.
